before.name: Sami al-Hajj
before.description: Sami al-Hajj is a Sudanese-born Al Jazeera cameraman who was arrested by Pakistani authorities on December 15, 2001, while travelling to report in Afghanistan. Amnesty International records his transfer to U.S. custody on January 7, 2002, followed by detention at Bagram, Kandahar and, from June 13, 2002, Guantanamo Bay. He was held without charge and alleged torture and ill-treatment. His employer records his release from U.S. custody on May 1, 2008; he was repatriated to Sudan and taken to hospital on arrival.
